newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets second one-week repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets second one-week repo tender.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) on Thursday set a one-week repo tender, its second of the day, at a maximum rate of 75 percent.
In the first repo tender of the day, all bids at the maximum set yield of 75 percent were accepted.
The CNB said in a statement that participants in the tender could submit two bids, with the minimum amount of 100 million crowns.
The CNB holds repo tenders to regulate liquidity on the market almost daily.
